skill.summary: Revise dense, unclear prose into clear, readable sentences by applying four diagnostic principles — characters-as-subjects, actions-as-verbs, old-before-new...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of prose-clarity-reviser.

- Introduces a skill for revising dense or unclear prose into clear, readable sentences using four principles: characters-as-subjects, actions-as-verbs, old-before-new information flow, and complexity-last sentence endings.
- Triggers on user requests to clarify or improve draft passages, including research papers, essays, reports, and professional documents.
- Requires a draft passage for revision and returns a revised version with brief annotations explaining changes.
- Applies all four diagnostic principles end-to-end, focusing on sentence and paragraph-level style (not argument restructuring).
